chapters.name: Number Sense and Operations
chapters.summary: Ordering fractions and decimals, factors and multiples, exponents and roots, absolute value, and multi-step arithmetic with rational numbers.
keyPoints: Convert numbers to one form (all decimals or all fractions) before comparing them.
Follow the order of operations: parentheses, exponents, multiply/divide, add/subtract.

chapters.name: Ratios, Proportions, and Percents
chapters.summary: Unit rates, proportions, scale factors, unit conversions, percent of a number, percent change, discounts, tax, and simple interest.
keyPoints: Percent change = (new - old) / old x 100.
Simple interest = principal x rate x time.

chapters.name: Perimeter, Area, and the Pythagorean Theorem
chapters.summary: Perimeter and area of rectangles, triangles, circles, polygons, and composite figures, and the Pythagorean theorem.
keyPoints: Circle: area = pi x r squared; circumference = 2 x pi x r.
In a right triangle, a squared + b squared = c squared.

chapters.name: Volume and Surface Area
chapters.summary: Volume and surface area of prisms, cylinders, pyramids, cones, spheres, and composite solids, using the formula sheet.
keyPoints: Volume of a prism or cylinder = base area x height.
A pyramid or cone holds one-third of the matching prism or cylinder.

chapters.name: Data, Statistics, and Probability
chapters.summary: Reading bar graphs, circle graphs, tables, and scatter plots; mean, median, mode, range, and weighted average; counting and simple probability.
keyPoints: The median is the middle value after the data are put in order.
Probability = favorable outcomes / total equally likely outcomes.

chapters.name: Expressions and Polynomials
chapters.summary: Writing expressions from words, evaluating expressions, combining like terms, multiplying and factoring polynomials, and rational expressions.
keyPoints: Only like terms (same variable and exponent) can be combined.
Use FOIL or the distributive property to multiply binomials.

chapters.name: Linear Equations and Systems
chapters.summary: Solving one-variable linear equations, writing equations from real situations, and solving systems of two linear equations.
keyPoints: Do the same operation to both sides to keep an equation balanced.
A system can be solved by substitution or elimination.

chapters.name: Linear Inequalities
chapters.summary: Solving and graphing one-variable inequalities and writing inequalities for real situations.
keyPoints: Flip the inequality sign when you multiply or divide by a negative number.
An open circle means the endpoint is not included.

chapters.name: Quadratic Equations
chapters.summary: Solving quadratic equations by factoring, square roots, and the quadratic formula, and using quadratics in word problems.
keyPoints: Set the equation equal to zero before factoring.
The quadratic formula is on the GED formula sheet.

chapters.name: Graphs, Slope, and Functions
chapters.summary: Points on the coordinate plane, slope, slope-intercept form, parallel and perpendicular lines, function notation, and reading key features of graphs.
keyPoints: Slope = rise / run = (y2 - y1) / (x2 - x1).
In y = mx + b, m is the slope and b is the y-intercept.
